head: The Lightning survive a scare
paras: This one got way too interesting for the Lightning. Neal Pionk, who scores in about 1 game in 12, scored twice. Brayden Point got the scoring started for the Lightning early in the first, but Pionk tied it up for Winnipeg late in the period, in his 600th NHL game. It was a busy second period. Conor Geekie put the Lightning ahead for good midway through the period. Anthony Cirelli and John Carlson scored a little over two minutes apart late in the period to stretch the lead to 4-1. Brandon Hagel made it 5-1, 56 seconds later, with Cirelli picking up his 200th NHL assist on the goal, and that one stood up as the winner. The third period was a wild one. Winnipeg pulled Stuart Skinner after five goals and turned to Nico Daws to start the third. Dylan Samberg and Pionk scored just under two minutes apart early in the third to cut Tampa Bay’s lead to 5-3. With the goalie pulled and less than three minutes left, Kyle Connor made it 5-4, and Pontus Holmberg shut the door with an empty-netter with a minute and a half left. Holmberg finished with four points on a goal and three assists, and Cirelli had a goal and two assists.

The Lightning carried the play, outshooting the Jets 31-21, and got the result to match. Andrei Vasilevskiy made 17 saves for the Bolts. The Lightning moved to 8-3-1, climbing to third in the Atlantic. The Jets dropped to 4-6-3, seventh in the Central.

items.text: Anthony Cirelli passed Brad Richards for ninth on the Lightning’s all-time goals list, with 151.
The Jets are winless in seven (0-5-2).
Dylan Samberg scored his first goal of the season, his first since Mar 3 (34 games played since).
The Lightning bounced back after two straight losses.
